description: Exploratory sub-decision-period command-transport latency from frozen K10 Navigator output to frozen locomotion velocity-command input. It starts after v1 0/20/40 ms quick passed and deliberately remains distinct from both Week 03 lower-level actuator delay and the later 200 ms-quantized high-level decision-delay test.

quick_gate.note: The stress ladder advances only when every frozen quick EpisodeSpec succeeds with no fall or invalid state. A timeout, fall, or invalid state defines the first failed delay tier.

full_gate.note: Formal is user-launched only after every quick condition passes. This stress-tier protocol is exploratory and does not replace the v1 0/20/40 ms formal protocol.
